name: University of Klagenfurt
summary: Campus university in Klagenfurt, Carinthia, with six bachelor's taught in English, from robotics and AI to business, media and social sciences.

ib.text: Austria accepts the IB Diploma without an equivalence check (ministry); AAU adds no IB rule. English-taught degrees need English B2, which an EU/EEA school-leaving English pass proves; no German needed.

programmes.name: International Business and Economics
programmes.ib: Special admission procedure: 50 places in 2026/27, a motivation letter and an online exam in English; 2026 registration ran 12 January to 23 February. 2027 dates not yet published.

notes: Only International Business and Economics has a selection; the other five admit everyone who meets the requirements.
In International Business and Economics you can add a year in Ljubljana from the third semester and earn a Slovenian degree as well, if nominated.
